## Just the Lamp

<!-- STEP id="isolate-the-lamp" -->
Isolate the lamp.

Forget the ceiling. Forget the string's other end. Just the lamp.

<!-- STEP id="two-forces" -->
## Two Forces, No More

Exactly two forces touch the lamp.

Its **weight** pulls straight down. The string's **tension** pulls straight up.

Tension is the pulling force carried through a taut string — the same idea from the last lesson's two boxes, now pulling the lamp toward the ceiling.

<!-- STEP id="balanced-so-equal" -->
## At Rest Means Balanced

The lamp isn't accelerating. It just hangs there.

By Newton's first law, a body that isn't accelerating has zero net force on it.

So the two arrows must be equal and opposite.

<!-- STEP id="the-result" -->
## The Equation

$$T = mg$$

**Two forces, at rest, always give you an equation this simple: the arrows must cancel.**
